Subject: Jordan Ellis — virtual loop: access, agenda & accommodations

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for interviewing with Redwood. We're looking forward to your virtual loop on Wednesday, Apr 28. Below are the logistics, agenda, and a quick note on accommodations — please let me know if anything else would make the experience smoother.

Join (Zoom): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=LobbyPass123
Meeting ID: 987 654 3210  | Passcode: Redwood28!
Host PIN (for phone hosts): 4321
Virtual lobby: we'll admit candidates from the waiting room at the scheduled start time; please join 5–10 minutes early so we can confirm audio/video.

Agenda (approx):
- 10:00–10:10 AM — Welcome & hiring manager intro (Laura Bennett)
- 10:10–10:40 AM — System design (SWE lead)
- 10:45–11:10 AM — Coding exercise (pairing)
- 11:15–11:30 AM — Wrap / next steps + recruiter Qs

Accessibility / accommodations: if you need live captions, extra time for the coding exercise, an ASL interpreter, or alternate format materials, tell us now and we'll arrange it. I cc'd our recruiter ops (Priyom) and Laura (hiring manager) to coordinate.

Attachments: I attached the agenda and the resume we have on file. If you'd like to send an updated copy, feel free.

Parking / travel: N/A for a virtual loop. If you need a backup phone dial-in, reply and I'll provide it.

Looking forward —
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

Thanks, Aditya — this looks great. Two quick notes:  
1) I would like live captions enabled during the loop; captions help me track the fast exchanges during the system design discussion.
2) For the coding exercise, could I get an extra 10 minutes? I process verbally and that small buffer helps me think aloud without losing my train.

If ASL is required (I can manage with captions) I will let you know, but captions are the main accommodation I need. Also: I uploaded a small resume tweak earlier today — attaching to this reply as well.

Best,
Jordan
jordan.ellis@example.com

Thanks for flagging, Jordan — happy to make that work. Quick notes for internal ops: 
- Priyom: please book live captions for the Zoom meeting and add the captioning provider to the calendar invite. If captions are unreliable, have the backup transcript capture enabled (Zoom cloud recording + transcript).
- Priyom: please also reserve 10 extra minutes for the coding exercise block (make the coding slot 30 minutes with the pair interviewer brief starting at 10:40). We'll keep total loop length roughly the same by tightening the intro.
- Aditya: I'm the hiring manager host for the intro and will be on camera. Interviewers assigned: Marcus Lin (system design), Chloe Martin (pairing/coding). Marcus will be primed to slow down questions when appropriate.

Jordan — CC'd Priyom will confirm the captioning and schedule tweak. If you prefer a specific captioning tool or need a human captioner, flag it and we'll arrange.

Laura
